While the search results in the screenshot still managed to surface the correct Wikipedia page for Dani Kouyaté (showing he was born in 1936), the agent's action was technically flawed due to the malformed query. More critically, the agent did not explicitly verify that the search results were actually for the correct person given the garbled query text visible in the URL and metadata (`Dani Kouyat\ufffde9`), relying on the fact that the top result happened to be correct. A robust agent should have either re-ran the search with the correct encoding or explicitly confirmed the entity before extracting the birth year. This execution error represents the first deviation from the successful process, although it coincidentally yielded the correct data point.
